We have applied template 38653 to target molecule, got two possible precursors (two SMILES). Need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available and total price <=9999. Need to verify each leaf is buyable. Also need to ensure each step uses a template that matches. We have one step now: target -> two precursors (maybe mixture). Need to further break each precursor into simpler buyable compounds.

We need to check buyability of these precursors. Use is_buyable.
